caption: The drawing depicts three distinct objects arranged against a neutral beige background. On the left side, there is a metal candleholder with a short stem mounted on a round, flat base colored with tones of dull blue and grey, and it is topped with a rectangular compartment or tray showing signs of tarnish. Below and slightly to the right of the candleholder, there is a pair of metal candle wick trimmers shaped like scissors, with two finger loops and a small box on one blade for collecting trimmings, rendered in silvery-grey hues with edges highlighted to show their sharpness. To the right of these objects, taking up most of the right side of the composition, there is a rectangular lantern with four vertical glass panels framed in a brownish metal structure, a perforated round lid on top, and an arched carrying handle. The metal framework and lid have a rusty brown appearance, while the glass panels show faint blue and green reflections, with one lower panel visibly cracked. The objects are all shown individually, not touching each other, and there are no extraneous background elements.
title: Zoar Candlestick, Snuffer and Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
